title: Clock permutation and Passive structural first-come priority

macro_program.name: order_time_session
macro_program.reason: The causal treatment is the evaluation-clock order that determines which component is already reserving capacity when a later passed signal reaches admission.

research_height.transfer: component clock and reservation interval -> individually pivotal capacity occupancy -> blocked target composition -> portfolio-priority decision

central_question: Does Passive's continuous evaluation and pending/position reservation make it a structurally privileged first-come occupant that is disproportionately pivotal when later component signals are blocked?

lenses: inclusive and fractional reserved-occupant attribution at every post-signal risk block
component risk-removal pivotality and occupancy-normalized pivotal rate
blocked target composition and same-period admitted-component stressed-R context
research_bundle.common_boundary: The complete frozen P4 candidate and lifecycle ledgers only; all fifteen post-pass blocks are a census, and no blocked outcome is imputed.

idea_provenance.original_strong_falsifier: If Passive occupies none of the P4 blocks and its occupancy-normalized block rate is the lowest, close the mechanism.

connection_bridge: Unit 061 froze the complete 4,043-row P4 funnel and identified fourteen aggregate-risk blocks plus one Passive price-distance block, but its additive slot formula was invalid and it did not attribute incumbents.
Unit 082 found frequent reachable Passive re-arm supply but no broad positive second-layer value, moving the unresolved Passive question from self-concurrency to cross-component displacement.
The raw candidate masks, lifecycle intervals and planned risks now allow exact union-mask and individually pivotal removal reconstruction without repairing Unit 061.

included_block_population.role: Risk blocks determine capacity pivotality; the one distance block is retained as a non-capacity negative control.

target_and_exclusions.included_occupancy: All six position intervals plus Passive pending-order intervals, using reserved-mask union semantics.

signal-unknown existing-exposure rows, blocked-candidate realized outcome imputation or an oracle selector

another period, threshold, subgroup, event, distance block as capacity evidence, MQL, runtime, compile, Tester or optimization

fixed_reconstruction.position_intervals: Pair every BIRTH to CLOSE by position_identifier and use [entry_time_server, close server_time). Planned risk is frozen from BIRTH.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending_intervals: For each Passive PENDING_ORDER candidate, start at candidate server_time and end at the unique Passive birth before decision_bar + 60 minutes or at expiry; planned risk comes from that candidate row.
fixed_reconstruction.active_mask: Union of position bits present at the block server_time.
fixed_reconstruction.reserved_mask: Active-mask union plus the Passive bit when a pending interval is present; never add active and reserved slot counts.
fixed_reconstruction.risk_before: Sum active-position planned risk and any Passive pending planned risk at the block time.
fixed_reconstruction.inclusive_attribution: Every reserved occupant receives one inclusive presence count for a risk block.
fixed_reconstruction.fractional_attribution: Each risk block contributes 1 / reserved_occupant_count to each reserved occupant.
fixed_reconstruction.individual_pivotality: An occupant is individually pivotal when attempted_aggregate_after_usd minus that occupant's planned risk is <= aggregate_cap_usd + $0.01.
fixed_reconstruction.occupancy_rate: Individually pivotal count per 1,000 reserved hours. Passive reserved hours are the union of position and pending intervals; other components use position intervals.
fixed_reconstruction.target_value_context: For each component, mean admitted P4 stressed R = CLOSE stressed_net_usd / planned_risk_usd. A blocked target receives only its component mean as context, never an imputed outcome.

requirements: All seven immutable files retain exact bytes/hashes; candidate and lifecycle row/schema/unique-id anchors pass.
Exactly fourteen aggregate-risk and one price-distance post-pass blocks reproduce; exactly 356 BIRTH/CLOSE pairs and 119 Passive pending intervals reproduce, with 92 fills and 27 expiries.
Every risk block joins to at least one reserved occupant; reconstructed active/reserved masks exactly match the logged masks and no attempted component is already reserved.
Reconstructed risk-before differs from logged aggregate_risk_before_usd by at most $0.02 on every risk block.
All six components have positive reserved hours, at least twenty admitted closes and finite mean stressed R.
Every inclusive, fractional and pivotal attribution is finite; fractional counts sum to fourteen.

decision_translation.if_priority_gate_passes: Retain one non-automatic future Lab priority candidate; do not change current first-come behavior or open a selector here.
decision_translation.if_falsifier_passes: Preserve first-come admission and close the claim that Passive structurally displaces later components.
decision_translation.if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve first-come and retain no candidate; record the P4 observation boundary without a larger-window or mask-formula rescue.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before the one aggregation.
A premetric correction may fix implementation plumbing only before any metric; no population, mask, risk, attribution, threshold, gate or decision may change.
If integrity fails, stop before authoritative attribution and close invalid without repairing Unit 061 or acquiring another period.
Do not infer the blocked candidates' realized outcomes, implement priority, alter any contract, or touch Program 6, broker/account state or Live.
automatic_followups_not_opened: priority selector, clock permutation or Passive suppression
larger period, relaxed block count, inclusive-only or pivotal-only rescue
Unit 061 slot arithmetic repair, pending-risk discount or component removal
